questionText: Which one of the options best describes the transformation of the 2-dimensional figure **P** to **Q**, and then to **R**, as shown?
options:
Operation 1: A clockwise rotation by $90^\circ$ about an axis perpendicular to the plane of the figure

Operation 2: A reflection along a horizontal line

Operation 1: A counter clockwise rotation by $90^\circ$ about an axis perpendicular to the plane of the figure

Operation 2: A reflection along a horizontal line

Operation 1: A clockwise rotation by $90^\circ$ about an axis perpendicular to the plane of the figure

Operation 2: A reflection along a vertical line

Operation 1: A counter clockwise rotation by $180^\circ$ about an axis perpendicular to the plane of the figure

Operation 2: A reflection along a vertical line
explanation:
Step 1: Analyzing Operation 1 (P to Q)
In figure P, the longest tip of the figure points towards the top-right. In figure Q, this same long tip points towards the bottom-right. Rotating figure P by $90^\circ$ clockwise about an axis perpendicular to its plane aligns the top-right tip to the bottom-right position. Thus, Operation 1 is a clockwise rotation by $90^\circ$.

Step 2: Analyzing Operation 2 (Q to R)
In figure Q, the long tip points downwards to the right, whereas in figure R, it points upwards to the right. Vertically flipping the figure across a horizontal axis converts figure Q into figure R. Thus, Operation 2 is a reflection along a horizontal line.

Therefore, Option (A) is correct.
